corrections.issue: Diagnostic Pack drift: Diagnostic Pack became perceived as main product
corrections.correction: Diagnostic Pack is a safety gate and evidence-augmentation layer, NOT the main product. Main product is the Build Harness.
corrections.evidence: AGENT-9-P3: Diagnostic Pack has process value but no product quality superiority over Vanilla

corrections.issue: SkillMarket as ongoing project: SkillMarket repair consumed mainline attention
corrections.correction: SkillMarket is an evidence object from a real-project trial. It is NOT an ongoing product or main project. No further repair.
corrections.evidence: 14 defects found, 8/8 repair tests pass, diagnostic accuracy confirmed — trial complete

corrections.issue: Multi-agent abandoned: Multi-agent work was deprioritized after not beating Vanilla
corrections.correction: Multi-agent remains a candidate mechanism for complex project production. Not default, but not abandoned. 4-agent P1 shows process benefits.
corrections.evidence: AGENT-9-P3: 4-agent P1 KEEP CONDITIONALLY. Complex project production may benefit from agent work allocation.

corrections.issue: Tiny phases proliferation: Many small diagnostic/repair phases consumed cycles without advancing mainline
corrections.correction: Each subsequent phase must cover complete large-block objectives. No more small diagnostic-only phases. User explicitly demands larger phases.
corrections.evidence: User directive: 每步尽量多做一点, 不要给大量小指令, 不要边做边忘主线

corrections.issue: Release/ZIP confusion: CODEX_FACTORY_V04_RELEASE_PACKAGE and FINAL_PACKAGE were created without clear build capability backing
corrections.correction: Release packaging is an output of proven build capability, not a goal in itself. Build harness must prove capability before release.
corrections.evidence: EVIDENCE_INDEX.md: Phase chain shows diagnostic value but no build harness evidence

corrections.issue: Benchmark without purpose: Second benchmark considered without clear build capability baseline
corrections.correction: Benchmark compares outcomes after build harness is operational. Benchmark is a measurement tool, not a build mechanism.
corrections.evidence: AGENT-9-P2: Benchmark scoring has methodology value but is not a production engine

corrections.issue: Core goal forgotten: Codex Factory's ultimate goal is to help Codex achieve its ceiling on complex projects, not to audit them
corrections.correction: Primary goal: Enable Codex to build truly complex projects. Diagnostic Pack is a stage-gate, not the destination.
corrections.evidence: Original Factory charter: verify and build Codex Factory to make Codex capable of more complex projects

mainlineResetPrinciples: Complex project production is the mainline
Diagnostic Pack is a gate, not the product
Multi-agent is a candidate mechanism, not default
External memory and continuation are required for complex projects
SkillMarket is closed as evidence object
forbiddenContinuations: Continuing Diagnostic Pack as main product
Treating Diagnostic Pack success as Factory completion
